submission.justification:
Absorber-F2 at 4 mm gives the best energy resolution at 100 GeV among the three candidates. The 5 mm baselines were F2 3.2%, F3 3.9%, F1 5.1%. The F2 thickness sweep has its minimum at 4 mm (3.056%), and the recorded final value is 3.13%. The refinement runs gave 3.203% at 4 mm, 3.185% at 3.5 mm and 3.28% at 4.5 mm, so the 4 mm choice is consistent within run-to-run scatter of about 0.1 percentage points. F2 is the best option at every thickness in the sweep. The plate thickness is within the 2-10 mm limit.

Maintenance access is not verified. Only 5 of the 6 project documents were reviewed, and none of those reviewed contained maintenance or access information, so there is no evidence either way. Before committing, the sixth document and the candidate_specs.md list should be checked, and hands-on access during shutdowns should be confirmed for a 4 mm F2 absorber stack.

requirements.requirement: Best possible energy resolution at 100 GeV
requirements.evidence: F2 at 4 mm is the lowest-resolution point found: 3.056% in the sweep, 3.13% recorded as final, 3.203% in refinement. The other candidates were F3 (best about 3.9%) and F1 (best about 5.1%) at 5 mm, and their sweeps showed no better points.

requirements.requirement: Absorber material is one of the three materials listed in candidate_specs.md
requirements.evidence: The F1/F2/F3 options were evaluated, but the constraint_candidate_list_ok flag is recorded as unverified and candidate_specs.md was not confirmed in the review.

requirements.requirement: Calorimeter allows hands-on maintenance during shutdowns
requirements.evidence: 0 maintenance or access documents and 0 maintenance restrictions were found, but only 5 of 6 project documents were reviewed. The maintenance check is recorded as not verified, so this is not confirmed as met.

requirements.requirement: Submit one recommended material and plate thickness
